source_blocks.heading: Browse with features that put you first
source_blocks.quote: Firefox was built to give you control.
source_blocks.context: Most browsers were built to capture your attention and monetize your data. Firefox was built to give you control.

source_blocks.heading: Made by people on the internet, for people on the internet
source_blocks.quote: Firefox blocks trackers automatically and protects your privacy by default, so you can browse confidently without becoming a privacy expert.
source_blocks.context: Staying safe online shouldn’t demand constant attention. Firefox blocks trackers automatically and protects your privacy by default, so you can browse confidently without becoming a privacy expert.

source_blocks.heading: Made by people on the internet, for people on the internet
source_blocks.quote: Firefox gives you real choices without burying you in settings.
source_blocks.context: Firefox gives you real choices without burying you in settings. Choose your tools, customize your experience, and decide how your browser works, instead of adapting to someone else’s defaults.

source_blocks.heading: Total cookie protection
source_blocks.quote: Cookies are one of the web’s favorite tracking tools, following you from site to site and quietly building a profile of your activity.
source_blocks.context: Cookies are one of the web’s favorite tracking tools, following you from site to site and quietly building a profile of your activity. Total Cookie Protection keeps each site’s cookies separate, so companies can’t connect the dots across your browsing.

source_blocks.heading: Enhanced Tracking Protection
source_blocks.quote: Just open Firefox and browse with protection already in place.
source_blocks.context: Firefox blocks thousands of known trackers before they can follow you around the web. No setup required. Just open Firefox and browse with protection already in place. You can also see what’s being blocked by clicking the shield icon in your address bar.

source_blocks.heading: Total cookie protection
source_blocks.quote: Total Cookie Protection keeps each site’s cookies separate, so companies can’t connect the dots across your browsing.
source_blocks.context: Cookies are one of the web’s favorite tracking tools, following you from site to site and quietly building a profile of your activity. Total Cookie Protection keeps each site’s cookies separate, so companies can’t connect the dots across your browsing.

source_blocks.heading: Your online life belongs to you
source_blocks.quote: Protection shouldn’t be a premium feature.
source_blocks.context: Protection shouldn’t be a premium feature. With Firefox, it’s built in. We block trackers automatically, protect your privacy by default, and give you clear visibility into what’s happening behind the scenes.
